name: Visa Research
draft_body:
Subject: CSOAI crosswalk — signed measurement of tokenized settlement

Hi Visa Research,

We have published a measurement of XRPL on-ledger settlement against the GENIUS Act §310 custody requirements. The CLARITY Act / Senate market-structure text (Sept 14) is crosswalked. CLARITY §501 transaction-integrity obligations are mapped to XRPL native primitives. Every figure is signed (Ed25519) and Bitcoin-anchored.

What we are NOT claiming:
  - that Visa accepts or endorses this
  - that XRPL is the only settlement rail
  - any specific institution is non-compliant

Best,
Nicholas Templeman

that any specific institution is non-compliant
